job.title: Procurement Auditor
job.description:
Temporary part-time Procurement Auditor 

***** Candidate needs to be able to start asap *****
***** Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!!

  • Work Schedule: This is a part-time role ~20 hours per week for 8-10 weeks ?9AM - 4PM Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
  • Location: 2 of the 3 days onsite or can be remote, preferred to have someone go onsite though. 1135 Tremont Street, Boston
  • Duration:  10 weeks (potential to extend to 12-14 weeks)
  • Pay Rate: $35-42/hr on W2 

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented, part-time temporary team member to support a supplier data audit project. This role involves reviewing existing supplier profiles for accuracy, updating payment terms, reviewing supplier contracts, and helping identify and confirm suppliers eligible for an upcoming virtual card payment program. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently with structured data and contract documents, has strong attention to detail, and can communicate professionally with internal stakeholders and, where needed, suppliers.


Key Responsibilities

• Audit existing supplier profiles in Jaggaer Supplier Management and Workday Finance for completeness and accuracy of key fields (contact information, tax ID, banking details, payment terms, etc.)

• Review current payment terms for each supplier and update records to reflect negotiated or standardized terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60)

• Review supplier contracts to verify that payment terms, pricing, and key terms on file match the executed agreement

• Identify contracts that are expired, missing, or due for renewal, and flag any discrepancies between contract terms and system records

• Flag discrepancies, missing data, or outdated information for follow-up with internal stakeholders or suppliers

• Contact suppliers directly, as needed, to obtain corrected or missing information and update supplier profiles to resolve identified issues

• Ensure updates to supplier profiles and payment terms are accurately reflected and synchronized across both Jaggaer Supplier Management and Workday Finance

• Evaluate supplier profiles against defined criteria to identify candidates suitable for the new virtual card payment program

• Confirm and document virtual card eligibility status for each reviewed supplier

• Maintain a clear audit log/tracker of changes made, suppliers reviewed, and open items requiring follow-up

• Communicate findings and status updates to the Accounts Payable/Procurement team on a regular cadence (e.g., weekly)

• Escalate any unusual account changes, potential fraud indicators, or supplier disputes to the appropriate manager

 

Qualifications

• Prior experience in accounts payable, procurement, vendor management, or a related administrative/finance function

• Comfort reviewing contract documents and reconciling contract terms against system data (no legal background required, but attention to detail with contract language is important)

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets/spreadsheets

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., filtering, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and/or Google Sheets

• Experience with Jaggaer Supplier Management and/or Workday Finance strongly preferred; experience with other ERP or supplier management systems also considered

• Familiarity with virtual card/commercial card payment programs a plus, but not required

• Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial data

• Strong written communication skills for documenting findings and liaising with stakeholders

• Comfortable initiating outreach to external suppliers (via phone or email) to request corrected information professionally and follow up until resolved

job.title: QC Inspector
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Control Inspector for our medical device client. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring incoming inventory and finished products meet established company quality standards. The Quality Control Inspector will perform incoming and outgoing inspections, review drawings and specifications, document inspection results, review Device History Records (DHRs), and support nonconformance and corrective action activities. This position requires strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively within a regulated medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device
Location: Redondo Beach
Compensation: $22/hr - $25/hr 
Type:Temp to Hire 

Job Functions
  • Perform incoming and outgoing inspections using appropriate inspection methods, including comparing products to established standards, measuring dimensions, and evaluating functionality.
  • Review drawings, specifications, and other technical documentation to verify products meet established quality requirements.
  • Record inspection results, complete inspection reports, and enter quality data into applicable databases.
  • Review manufacturing Device History Records (DHRs) for accuracy and completeness.
  • Collect, compile, and maintain statistical quality data.
  • Assist with the development of test methods and inspection plans.
  • Support monitoring of office and warehouse cleanliness.
  • Monitor equipment usage to help ensure equipment is operated safely.
  • Investigate product defects and assist in determining root cause.
  • Identify and appropriately disposition products that do not meet established quality requirements.

job.title: Email Marketing Specialist
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our global media and entertainment client. This role will support the day-to-day production and execution of high-volume email campaigns, including newsletters, promotional communications, advertising initiatives, holiday campaigns, and international campaigns. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of experience in email marketing or digital campaign production, with strong attention to detail, hands-on experience formatting emails, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Email Marketing Specialist
Compensation: $30-35/hr
Type: 4 Month Contract with ability to extend or Convert
Location: Washington, DC area
 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, format, and deploy mobile-optimized email campaigns, newsletters, promotional communications, and automated email sequences.
  • Manage approximately 10 campaigns at various stages of development while supporting a high-volume team producing approximately 70 campaigns and projects per month.
  • Edit email content, images, banners, metadata, and minor HTML to ensure campaigns meet established quality and formatting standards.
  • Schedule email deployments and coordinate launch details across multiple stakeholders.
  • Insert and format promotional banners and supporting creative within email communications.
  • Conduct quality assurance testing to verify accurate content, links, tracking parameters, metadata, and rendering across desktop and mobile devices.
  • Develop and distribute campaign proofs for stakeholder review, feedback, and approval.
  • Execute A/B testing on subject lines, calls to action, send times, and other campaign elements.
  • Monitor campaign progress and communicate updates, risks, and required actions to project stakeholders.
  • Manage assignments, deadlines, approvals, and project status using Jira or similar project management tools.
  • Follow email marketing best practices, brand standards, privacy requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
  • Support occasional time-sensitive or breaking-news email deployments as needed.
Basic Qualifications:

  • 2–3 years of professional experience in email marketing, digital campaign production, marketing operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a large, high-volume corporate or media environment with tight deadlines.
  • Associate degree or equivalent professional experience required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Working knowledge of email marketing platforms and campaign management tools, such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with email formatting, minor HTML editing, and HTML coding concepts.
  • Familiarity with Photoshop or similar tools for editing and preparing digital assets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Jira or comparable project management software.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and work independently after training.
  • Ability to work onsite Monday through Thursday in the Washington, DC area and remotely on Fridays.
  • Flexibility to support occasional off-hours or time-sensitive campaign deployments.

job.title: Compliance and Operations Analyst
job.description:
Compliance and Operations Analyst
6+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid)
 
The Compliance and Operations Analyst supports the daily operation, security, and compliance of the organization's Transmission Management System (TMS) environment, ensuring adherence to applicable NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards and internal security protocols. This role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving NERC CIP policies, plans, procedures, and supporting documentation, as well as coordinating compliance activities across technical and business teams.

The analyst works closely with Operations, Security, Engineering, and Compliance stakeholders to identify risks, implement controls, and drive operational and process improvements that enhance system reliability, security, and regulatory compliance. The position plays a key role in facilitating change management activities by ensuring that operational changes are evaluated, implemented, and documented in a secure and compliant manner while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the TMS environment.

Responsibilities:
 
  • Support daily operational activities within the TMS environment.
  • Maintain and enhance NERC CIP compliance documentation, including policies, plans, procedures, and evidence repositories.
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable NERC CIP, regulatory, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Analyze operational and compliance processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, standardization, risk reduction, and regulatory readiness.
  • Partner with Operations, Cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to plan, review, and implement changes in a secure, reliable, and compliant manner.
  • Support vulnerability management, patch management, and baseline configuration monitoring activities.
  • Communicate effectively as a liaison between technical teams, program management, project sponsors, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure cybersecurity and compliance controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, including compliance evidence management and audit support activities.

Key Qualifications:
 
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting regulated operational technology (OT), transmission operations, cybersecurity, compliance, or related utility environments.
  • Knowledge of NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards and their application within electric utility environments.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and managing policies, plans, procedures, standards, and compliance documentation.
  • Understanding of Transmission Management Systems (TMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Operational Technology (OT), or other critical infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, including vulnerability management, patch management, access management, and configuration management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks, compliance gaps, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  • Experience coordinating activities across technical teams, compliance personnel, business stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused communications.
  • Knowledge of change management processes and the ability to support secure and compliant implementation of operational changes.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and recordkeeping.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating within cross-functional teams.

Measurements:
  • Maintains a high level of client satisfaction and builds positive effective relationships with clients and related stakeholders
  • Effective actions taken to minimize risk across Oncor
  • A track record of collaborative participation in the management of Oncor’s technology platforms
  • Compliance with applicable NERC CIP, FAA, FCC, etc. regulations
  • Effective documentation and communication of project milestones, risks, issues, deliverables, escalations, etc.

job.title: Registered Nurse
job.description:
RN needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s food manufacturing client located in Hanover, PA. This primary care clinic provides pediatric, woman, and adult care. Seeking and RN with experience in phlebotomy and EPIC as well as a willingness to support administration.
 
Schedule: Monday 7a-1p, Tuesday 11a-7p, Thursday 11a-4p, Friday 8a-3p
Duration: 5 months with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $38-50/HR depending experience
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Uses nursing skills to evaluate patient care needs, prioritize treatment, and maintain patient flow.
  • Conducts a nursing assessment by taking a patient history and physical assessment and by obtaining vital signs and other medical tests. Provides treatment within scope of practice as defined by state law.
  • Collaborates with Physician or other Licensed Independent Practitioner to arrange for further medical treatment, when needed.
  • Identifies equipment that needs repair and brings it to the attention of the lead clinician.

  • Evaluates health education/promotion needs of patients and provides necessary training and instruction.
  • Identifies emergency situations and provides care within legal scope of practice.
  • Administers medications and medical treatments competently as directed by a Physician or Licensed Independent Practitioner.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).
  • Maintains a clean and safe environment. Follows infection control procedures.
  • Maintains patient privacy and confidential patient information.
  • Participates in follow up phone calls and follow up patient visits.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • RN License to practice in PA
  • BLS upon hire
  • Strong phlebotomy skills
  • Epic and front desk experience is preferred

job.title: Android Team Lead, Dallas, TX
job.description:
Lead Android Developer (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose)
Direct Hire
Richardson, TX (ONSITE)
 
Position Summary
We’re seeking a Lead Android Developer to design, build, and lead delivery of commercial-grade Android applications for a consumer banking environment. This role blends hands-on mobile engineering (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) with Agile team leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and strong influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders. You’ll help shape mobile architecture, champion quality and UX best practices, and drive reliable releases through modern CI/CD.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design and development of production Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
  • Own and evolve the mobile architecture (patterns, modularization, maintainability, performance, security, and test strategy).
  • Partner with product, design, QA, and backend teams to deliver high-quality features for consumer banking, including account management and customer onboarding.
  • Drive Agile execution: facilitate team rituals, refine stories, mentor engineers, and remove delivery blockers.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and appropriate third-party libraries, ensuring reliability, scalability, and secure data handling.
  • Champion mobile UI/UX principles and accessibility best practices to create intuitive, engaging customer experiences.
  • Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines for mobile builds, testing, and deployment; ensure consistent release quality.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, translating technical tradeoffs into business impact and influencing decisions.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 10–12+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial-grade software systems.
  • 4+ years leading Agile teams (formal or informal leadership: tech lead, lead engineer, team lead).
  • Expert-level experience building production Android apps with:
    • Kotlin
    • Jetpack Compose
  • Experience in consumer banking, specifically account management and onboarding.
  • Strong experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices (responsiveness, accessibility, consistency, usability).

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting product and manufacturing quality through inspection and testing strategies, defect analysis, statistical analysis, documentation control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Development, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to ensure products and processes meet company, customer, and industry quality standards. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify quality issues, develop effective solutions, and drive improvements in a regulated environment.

Industry: Medical Device 
Location: Redondo Beach, CA
Compensation: $48.00–$50.00/hour
Type: Temp-to-Hire

Job Functions
  • Review and thoroughly understand product functional and design specifications.
  • Develop and implement methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Design or specify inspection and testing mechanisms and equipment.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance testing to ensure products meet established requirements.
  • Perform statistical analysis to evaluate products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct defect analysis utilizing statistical quality and process analytical methods.
  • Prepare and maintain Quality reports and support documentation control systems.
  • Review returned materials and verify customer complaints, developing action plans to address identified discrepancies.
  • Communicate with customers regarding Quality issues and resolutions as required.
  • Partner with operators and technicians to identify and resolve day-to-day Quality Assurance issues.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects while working within design specifications and budget requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of evolving Quality Assurance codes, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Document test cases and interpret technical and business objectives.
  • Work closely with Development and Product teams to support Quality initiatives.
  • Identify software bugs and support appropriate testing and resolution activities.
  • Recommend changes and improvements to enhance overall product quality.
  • Ensure products comply with company and applicable industry Quality standards.
  • Develop and implement systems that promote conformity and accuracy throughout the production process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions for identified Quality and product issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; Master's degree in Engineering preferred.
  • Professional certifications or 10+ years of equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Previous experience working in a Quality Assurance environment required.
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable EU standards.
  • MDR experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance and testing tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and scripting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office and technical equipment.
  • Ability to work within manufacturing, Quality, and product development environments as required.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, test results, and Quality records for extended periods.

Qualifications

  • Must be able to multi-task effectively
  • Great organizational skills

job.title: Research Scientist, Automation/Biochemistry
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term opportunity for a Scientist within Automation/Biochemistry for a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 


Key Responsibilities:
Laboratory Automation:
  • Develop and test protocols on complex, integrated laboratory automation systems
  • Problem solve and implement custom solutions for scientists using automation work cells
  • Implementation of liquid handling methods across a variety of available equipment
  • Work with scientists to set up interfaces between databases and laboratory instrumentation
  • Troubleshoot and aid with error handling and maintenance of automation systems
  • Regularly provide and update technical documentation
  • Provide user support and training
Database and inventory management
  • Work with internal automation, digital, and computational teams to implement data management and visualization best practices.                                
  • Statistical interpretation and data correlation (PCA, tSNE, or similar)
  • Data analysis for a myriad of biochemical data including protein-protein interactions (ELISA, SPR, BLI…), protein quality (SEC, DSF, DSC…), biochemical (SEC, protein thermal shift…) and biophysical (SPR, BLI…)      
  • Demonstrate technical proficiency with the ability to problem solve in a broad array of experimental protocols.
Project Contribution
  • Present concise scientific presentations in line with project objectives
  • Support and in some cases lead internal site-specific projects.
  • Assist with and/or prepare publications, proposals, reports, patents, and grant applications.
  • Critically evaluate relevant literature to provide experimental and strategic input to senior team members as needed.
  • Actively take part in the training of technical staff
GRP and HSE
  • Comply with the company safety policies and HSE to minimize risk to self, others and the environment, consistent with HSE policies, community and industry standards.
  • Identify and help to improve best practices in HSE operations.
  • Ensure documentation of laboratory experiments are entered in ELSE in a timely manner: analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data.
  • Participate in generating/reviewing SOPs and other required documents.
  • Remain compliant with applicable trainings.
Qualifications & Skills:
Ph.D. in data science, computer science, or related field with 0-2 years of experience, or Masters’ degree and 5 years’ experience. Knowledge and hands-on experience with Hamilton Venus, Cellario (or other integration scheduling software), GeneData Biologics, Benchling, and/or Python and basic computer programming.
Strong interpersonal, communication, collaboration, leadership, and problem-solving skills are required.
Understanding of laboratory practices and biochemical/scientific terminology are required.

job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse (RN) needed for a part-time, 24 hours per week, temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-established client located in Cedar Rapids, IA.
---> Job is anticipating to transition to full-time Monday-Friday around September 2026 with opportunity for temp-to-hire!


This clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees onsite. Duties will consist of first-aid, basic walk-in care (minor acute care like colds, rashes, pink eye, etc.), assisting with surveillance exams, responding to medical emergencies, and a lot of computer work.

--> SHIFTS: anticipating to be 3 days a week between Monday and Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm and if chosen for the long-term opening, hours will transition to full-time Monday-Friday, 7:30am to 4:00pm. 


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of Iowa
  • Minimum 3 years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Preferred experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, School Nursing, Corrections or Family Medicine type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and computer literate

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Provide wellness materials/information
  • Medical surveillance exams (ie hearing conservation)
  • Provide medical testing such as EKGs, pulmonary function, blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol, vision and hearing screening and perform limited interpretation of tests
  • Refer to higher level of care
  • Respond to emergencies and provide emergency medical care for employees onsite

  • Previous experience using EPIC a plus!
  • BLS certified (hands on courses only - strictly online not accepted)
  • Yearly TB test or QuantiFERON Gold
  • Must have proof of US Citizenship (ie valid US Passport or original US Birth Certificate) for security clearance/badging

  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends needed
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Balance of both clinical and administrative tasks

  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

job.title: Scientist – Functional Proteomics
job.description:
Scientist – Functional Proteomics

Location: Seattle, WA
Compensation: $115,000–$150,000 annual base salary
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Work Arrangement: Primarily onsite

Yoh is proactively seeking a Scientist – Functional Proteomics for an anticipated opportunity with a biotechnology company in Seattle, WA.

We are looking for a hands-on scientist with expertise in mass spectrometry-based proteomics who can design rigorous quantitative experiments and translate complex proteomic data into meaningful biological insights. This position will support drug-discovery research involving target identification and validation, compound characterization, and mechanism-of-action studies.

The ideal candidate combines strong experimental proteomics capabilities with a deep understanding of protein biology and the ability to collaborate across experimental biology, computational science, and drug-discovery teams.

What You'll Do
  • Design and execute quantitative and functional proteomics experiments supporting target discovery, target validation, compound profiling, and mechanism-of-action research.
  • Develop and optimize protein extraction, digestion, enrichment, fractionation, and sample-preparation workflows for mass spectrometry-based studies.
  • Design studies evaluating protein abundance, activity, binding, localization, and responses to compound treatment.
  • Establish appropriate experimental controls, biological and technical replicates, normalization strategies, and quantitative approaches.
  • Develop proteomic strategies for challenging protein classes, including transcription factors, chromatin-associated proteins, and other regulatory proteins.
  • Perform mammalian cell culture and cellular compound-treatment experiments as needed.
  • Generate, analyze, and interpret quantitative proteomics datasets in collaboration with computational scientists.
  • Integrate proteomic findings with genomic, transcriptomic, cellular, and pharmacological datasets to develop biological conclusions.
  • Troubleshoot experimental workflows and improve sensitivity, reproducibility, robustness, and throughput.
  • Support the development of automated and high-throughput proteomics workflows.
  • Present experimental findings, scientific interpretations, and recommendations to cross-functional project teams.
  • Contribute to scientific strategy, technical documentation, publications, and presentations.

What We're Looking For
  • Ph.D. in proteomics, biochemistry, molecular biology, chemical biology, analytical chemistry, systems biology, or a related scientific discipline preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with mass spectrometry-based proteomics.
  • Strong understanding of quantitative proteomics experimental design, including sample preparation, controls, replicates, and normalization.
  • Experience generating, processing, and/or interpreting quantitative proteomics datasets.
  • Strong foundation in protein biology and hypothesis-driven experimental science.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex datasets into meaningful biological conclusions.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot experimental workflows and make scientifically sound decisions.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary scientific teams.

Highly Relevant Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:
  • Functional proteomics or chemoproteomics
  • Compound-target identification or target-engagement studies
  • Target discovery, target validation, or mechanism-of-action research
  • Thermal proteome profiling or other protein-stability approaches
  • Affinity-based or enrichment-based proteomic methods
  • DIA, label-free, isotopic, or multiplexed quantitative proteomics
  • Nuclear, chromatin, or transcription-factor proteomics
  • Mammalian cell culture and compound-treatment studies
  • Drug discovery or pharmacology
  • Automated or high-throughput proteomics workflows
  • Proteomics analysis tools such as DIA-NN, Spectronaut, Skyline, FragPipe, MaxQuant, or similar platforms
  • Python and/or R
Additional Information
This position is anticipated to be primarily onsite in Seattle, WA and will work across experimental biology, analytical science, and computational disciplines. This is an anticipated upcoming hiring need, and Yoh is currently building a pipeline of qualified scientists for consideration as the opportunity progresses.

job.title: Research Associate II – Drug Discovery
job.description:
Research Associate II – Drug Discovery

Seattle, WA | Onsite | Direct Hire
Anticipated Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000

Yoh is proactively building a talent pipeline for an anticipated Research Associate II – Drug Discovery opportunity with a biotechnology company in Seattle, WA.

We are seeking a hands-on bench scientist with particularly strong RT-qPCR and mammalian cell culture experience who enjoys assay development, troubleshooting, and supporting early-stage drug discovery research.

This individual will work closely with scientists across biology, proteomics, automation, and computational disciplines to execute molecular and cell-based experiments, evaluate compound activity, validate screening hits, and optimize assays supporting drug discovery programs.

What You’ll Do
  • Perform mammalian cell culture, including maintenance and experimental manipulation of cancer cell lines.
  • Execute RT-qPCR and multiplex RT-qPCR assays to evaluate gene expression and compound activity.
  • Design, evaluate, and optimize primers, probes, and oligonucleotides.
  • Conduct cell-based assays, including viability, proliferation, apoptosis, reporter, and compound-response assays.
  • Perform compound-treatment, dose-response, and follow-up validation experiments.
  • Support validation and characterization of hits identified through screening campaigns.
  • Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and scale molecular and cell-based biological assays.
  • Analyze experimental results and communicate findings to cross-functional scientific teams.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory documentation, protocols, and experimental records.
  • Collaborate with scientists across biology, proteomics, automation, and computational/data-science functions.

What We’re Looking For
  • Bachelor’s degree in biology, molecular biology, cell biology, cancer biology, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Approximately 3+ years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience; candidates with a master’s degree and relevant practical laboratory experience may also be considered.
  • Strong hands-on RT-qPCR experience.
  • Strong hands-on mammalian cell-culture experience.
  • Experience designing, selecting, or optimizing primers, probes, or oligonucleotides.
  • Experience developing, optimizing, or troubleshooting biological assays.
  • Ability to independently organize, execute, document, and analyze multiple experiments.
  • Strong scientific communication and laboratory documentation skills.

Preferred Experience
  • Biotechnology or pharmaceutical drug-discovery experience.
  • Experience working with cancer cell lines.
  • Compound screening or hit-validation experience.
  • Multiplex RT-qPCR.
  • CRISPR, RNAi, transfection, or related gene-perturbation techniques.
  • Gene-regulation or transcription-factor biology.
  • Medium- or high-throughput screening.
  • Laboratory automation.
  • GraphPad Prism or similar scientific-analysis software.

Ideal Candidate
The strongest candidate will be a hands-on Research Associate who has personally performed RT-qPCR and mammalian cell culture at the bench and can speak in detail about assay optimization, troubleshooting, experimental design, and data interpretation.

This opportunity is especially well suited for a scientist who enjoys solving experimental problems, working across multiple biological techniques, and contributing directly to fast-moving drug-discovery programs.

Position Details
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Location: Seattle, WA
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Anticipated Base Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000 annually

job.title: Sr. Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Sr. Engineer - Process Development
Primary Duties: The Sr. Engineer reports to Principal Engineer and is an integral part of mRNA Drug Substance Process Development team. This position offers opportunities to focus on mRNA drug substance process development, manufacturing, regulatory and analytical support, validation, and data review for drug substances and drug products. The Engineer is responsible for leading and assisting the development and execution of scalable and robust processes for drug substance. This position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for process knowledge transfer for drug substance to support current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) manufacturing.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
40%
    • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues, and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality
    • Scale-up:
      • Lead/Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
40%
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Lead implementation of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
10%
    • Lead project activities for the design of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
    • Document Generation
      • Author and review MBRs
      • Author and review SOPs
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Manufacturing Analytical
5%
    • Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assuance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
    • Work with internal and external manufacturing on harmonization of electronic batch records.
    • Work with Digital team withing PD and CMC on the implementation of eBRs and data capture strategy.
    • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale.
    • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
    • Review and follow QA procedures.
5%
    • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements
    • Technical reports (2.5%)
      • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
    • Presentations (2.5%)
    • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.

Education and Experience Requirements:
    • 6+ (Masters) or 8+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required.
    • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
    • Demonstrated experience in process development, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals is required.
    • Experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, MSAT, and/or Process Development (PD) is required (4+ years).
    • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred. 
    • Experience implementing and maintaining electronic batch records (eBRs) is required (1+ years).  Experience using Tempo Apprentice strongly preferred.

job.title: QA Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a QA Specialist,  for our diagnostics customer in North County San Diego.  The QA Specialist will be ensuring effective management of documentation, training, and quality system processes in compliance with FDA quality system regulations and applicable ISO standards

Pay Rate - $35-$43/hr
Schedule - 8am - 4:30pm 
Location - Carlsbad
Duration - contract-to-hire

Responsibilities:
  • Under the direction of the Senior Quality Systems Manager, this position is responsible for maintaining Document Control and Training Management Systems in compliance with internal procedures and applicable global regulations. 
  • Ensure products or services meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Review, approve, and release batch records in accordance with approved procedures and documented acceptance criteria within defined timelines.
  • Generate certificates of compliance, information sheets, manufacturing declarations and USDSA APHIS documentation for outgoing shipments.
  • Perform verification and effectiveness checks for CAPAs, deviations, and nonconformance reports, including documentation of objective evidence to support effectiveness and formal closure.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of cGMP and GDP by independently scheduling and conducting monthly laboratory walk-throughs and annual internal audits based on an approved audit schedule, with documented action reports and follow-up tracking.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify documented root causes using appropriate analytical methods and support corrective and preventive actions.
  • Complete customer and vendor quality questionnaires.
  • Support Management Review meetings by preparing and presenting quality metrics, trends, and performance data to support management review inputs and documented outputs.
  • Maintain and manage Quality Management System (QMS) subsystems in accordance with regulatory and standard requirements, including: CAPAs, NCRs, Customer Complaints, Doc Control, Equipment and Facilities support, and Supplier qualification and management. 
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline or Associate’s degree in a scientific discipline with relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of QA work experience.
  • Quality Assurance experience in a cGMP and/or manufacturing environment
  • Working knowledge of FDA QMSR, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 14971
  • Experience with GDP

job.title: Core/Senior Network Engineer - Wayne PA - RTH
job.description:
This is a Right to Hire role working onside in Wayne PA

Core/Senior Network Engineer
Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Network Engineer to join our infrastructure team and support a large enterprise office environment. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting network technologies across a multi-vendor ecosystem while driving network automation initiatives and supporting broader cybersecurity efforts.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in enterprise networking, strong automation capabilities, and a collaborative mindset. In addition to maintaining a reliable and secure network infrastructure, this individual will work closely with desktop support, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure exceptional technology services for a large user population.
This position requires an onsite presence four days per week and involves direct support of office-based technology operations.
Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, support, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across a multi-vendor environment.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routing and switching technologies.
  • Support a diverse technology stack including solutions from HPE, Aruba, Cisco, Palo Alto, Zscaler, and other industry-leading vendors.
  • Manage and support firewalls, secure web gateways, proxy services, and network security technologies.
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python, Ansible, and related automation frameworks.
  • Automate network provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and operational workflows.
  • Support enterprise wireless and Wi-Fi infrastructure, including deployment, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Troubleshoot complex network performance, connectivity, and security issues.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams on infrastructure hardening, security initiatives, and network-related projects.
  • Collaborate with desktop support and workplace technology teams to resolve end-user technology issues and improve service delivery.
  • Evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and related technologies, to enhance operational efficiency and automation.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects involving networking, security, cloud connectivity, and office technology modernization.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
Qualifications
Required Experience
  • 5+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
  • Strong knowledge of routing and switching protocols and architectures.
  • Experience supporting enterprise firewall and network security technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Experience working within multi-vendor networking environments.
  • Strong understanding of wireless and Wi-Fi technologies.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and connectivity issues.
  • Experience supporting corporate office environments and end-user technology services.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience with HPE, Aruba, Cisco, Palo Alto, and/or Zscaler technologies.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise office environments.
  • Exposure to cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure architectures.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted operational tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.
  • Experience participating in cybersecurity and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Keys to the Position
  1. Core/Senior-level enterprise networking expertise with strong routing, switching, and network operations experience.
  2. Network automation experience using Python, Ansible, or similar automation technologies.
  3. Multi-vendor network environment experience (Cisco, HPE, Aruba, Palo Alto, Zscaler, etc.).
  4. Hands-on support mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve real-time networking issues.
  5. Strong wireless/Wi-Fi expertise within enterprise environments.
  6. Network security knowledge, including firewalls, web proxies, and secure access technologies.
  7. Collaborative approach and willingness to support desktop, infrastructure, and security teams as needed.
  8. Interest in emerging technologies and AI tools that can improve operational efficiency and automation.
  9. Comfort working onsite four days per week and supporting a large office environment.
  10. Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Why This Role Stands Out
This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting a modern enterprise networking environment while driving automation, improving security posture, and influencing the adoption of emerging technologies. The position offers broad exposure across networking, cybersecurity, workplace technology, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

job.title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer - DIRECT HIRE - NO THIRD PARTY CANDIDATES
job.description:
** Open to 100% remote in EST and CST**
***Ideal profile is someone who has worked as a Tech Lead and managed 3-4 resources or more, mid size company with SaaS type product focus***

Senior Software Engineer – Services
Position Overview
  • Our client is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Services to help mature and scale the cloud-based microservices platform that powers its customer-facing products and operational systems.
  • This role is comparable to a technical lead position. The successful candidate will lead a small team of approximately three to four engineers, guide moderately complex projects, mentor junior developers, and contribute hands-on throughout the full software development lifecycle.
  • The ideal candidate has approximately seven to ten years of software engineering experience and is already operating at a senior or technical-lead level. This person should be comfortable working across databases, APIs, user-interface integrations, batch jobs, and asynchronous messaging workflows.
  • The primary technology environment includes Kotlin, JVM/Spring, Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with other languages and cloud platforms is welcome.

What You’ll Do
  • Lead a small engineering team through the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Produce architectural proposals and participate in technical design discussions and platform-evolution decisions.
  • Coordinate work across multiple services, teams, and project dependencies.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to evaluate technical feasibility and design effective solutions.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable microservices backed by relational and non-relational databases.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, batch processes, and asynchronous messaging workflows.
  • Work with Kafka to support event-driven communication between product, inventory, checkout, and warehouse systems.
  • Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and queries supporting systems with hundreds of millions of records.
  • Refactor and improve data structures, including the use of denormalization and event-driven data flows where appropriate.
  • Deliver the full lifecycle of production-ready features, including design, coding, testing, configuration, documentation, deployment, and operational support.
  • Use feature flags and other deployment strategies to keep live systems stable while changes are introduced.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, design discussions, and technical guidance.
  • Review work, identify risks, escalate issues, and help keep project dependencies aligned.
  • Participate in incident response, operational support, and post-mortem analysis.
  • Contribute to system reliability practices, development standards, tooling, and process improvements.
  • Collaborate with QA and Platform Engineering to maintain effective testing and integrated development environments.
  • Provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams regarding integration approaches, system constraints, and architectural tradeoffs.
  • Contribute improvements to the CI/CD pipeline as appropriate. We are transitioning from Harness to GitHub Actions, with the pipeline primarily maintained
by the operations team.

Representative Project Scope
A typical initiative may involve expanding the platform to support both renting and purchasing products. The work could include:
  • Updating product data models and APIs to support new product categories.
  • Consuming product updates from Kafka topics.
  • Enhancing cart services to support rental and purchase items simultaneously.
  • Updating APIs to distinguish between rental and purchase transactions.
  • Using Kafka-based asynchronous workflows to call inventory systems and reserve items.
  • Implementing time-based batch jobs to expire cart reservations.
  • Publishing order information to Kafka topics for warehouse processing.
  • Coordinating approximately 50 Jira stories across multiple services and teams.
  • Using feature flags to maintain system availability during the rollout.
Projects of this scope typically take approximately six months and require broad architectural understanding across databases, APIs, messaging, batch processing, and customer-facing services.

Required Qualifications
  • Approximately seven to ten years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated senior-level or technical-lead responsibilities.
  • Experience leading a small team or coordinating the technical delivery of moderately complex projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kotlin, Java, Scala, or another JVM-based language.
  • Experience with Spring or Spring Boot; Kotlin and JVM/Spring experience are strongly preferred.
  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating microservices.
  • Experience with Kafka or comparable messaging and event-streaming technologies; Kafka experience is critical.
  • Hands-on experience with Postgres or another relational database, including data modeling, query optimization, schema evolution, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, HTTP protocols, and service-integration patterns.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, consistency models, asynchronous processing, and microservices tradeoffs.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable container technologies.
  • Experience with GCP or another major cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.
  • Exposure to full-stack systems, including UI-integrated services, APIs, batch jobs, databases, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software testing, automated testing, test-driven development, and reliable production systems.
  • Ability to quickly understand an existing codebase, architecture, and toolset.
  • Ability to communicate effectively across engineering, product, QA, platform, and other functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, and provide constructive technical leadership.


AI-Assisted Development Expectations
We have implemented a spec-driven development workflow across its engineering teams. Engineers use AI tools to help create technical specifications, execute against those specifications, and peer-review the resulting work.

Candidates are not required to have experience with this exact AI harness, but they must be open to adopting mandated AI-assisted development tools and workflows. Candidates should demonstrate:
  • Practical experience using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms.
  • Excitement and willingness to use AI-assisted development as part of everyday engineering work.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and how to provide effective technical context to AI tools.
  • Familiarity with structured AI guidance, including system prompts, rules files, agent configurations, or similar approaches.
  • Understanding of AI tool integrations, connectors, MCP, and agentic workflows.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve engineering efficiency and quality.
  • Strong architectural judgment to define, review, and validate AI-generated specifications and code.
Experience designing or building an AI development harness for an engineering team is a plus and may be relevant to additional opportunities within the organization.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Kafka-based event-driven architectures at scale.
  • Experience with Kubernetes service design and zero-downtime deployment practices.
  • Experience with GCP services, although AWS or Azure experience is transferable.
  • Experience with TypeScript, Python, or other programming languages.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, customer-facing systems.
  • Experience improving query performance and optimizing databases with large data volumes.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools, GitHub Actions, Harness, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with feature flags, progressive delivery, and production rollout strategies.
  • Experience participating in incident response and post-mortem processes.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Target salary is $160K plus 20% bonus (individual and company) – in recent years this almost always pays out at or near 20%

job.title: Sr. Research Associate- ESI Flow Cytometry
job.description:
Research Associate - ESI Flow Cytometry
Primary Duties: The Yoh resource is expected to apply expertise across several practical skills including flow cytometry and cell sorting in support of the Client’s Vaccines R&D Global Immunology function. The role is a lab-based research scientist who will be participating in various teams to support preclinical and early clinical evaluation of vaccine candidates against various respiratory viruses. Knowledge of immunoassay instruments, including flow cytometer analyzers, high-speed sorter, centrifuges, multi-mode plate readers and plate washers will be required. Individual will be performing laboratory work including flow cytometry and immunoassays, recording data in specified formats and/or recording detailed day-to-day work in electronic laboratory notebook. Responsibilities will include reagent preparation, lab housekeeping and flow cytometry analyzers and cell sorters maintenance. Applicant must be capable of working both independently and as part of a structured team.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support experimental assay design, optimization, and execute multi-parameter flow cytometry panels (beyond 20 colors) for comprehensive T cell and B cell subset identification
  • Execute multi-cytokine  Intracellular Cytokine Staining (ICS) assays (IFN-?, TNF-?, IL-2, IL-4, IL-17, etc.) following antigen-specific stimulationOperate and maintain flow cytometers (conventional and spectral platforms) with adherence to quality control protocols
  • Execute high-speed, high-purity cell sorting using Sony or similar instrumentation for isolation of antigen-specific T cell and B cell populations or other cell subsets of interest.
  • Optimize sort gates and collection strategies to maximize cell recovery and purity
  • Troubleshoot sort performance issues including clogging, deflection plate alignment, and collection efficiency
  • Analyze flow cytometry data using industry-standard software (OMIQ)
  • Apply appropriate gating strategies following established SOPs and scientific best practices
  • Analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data in electronic laboratory notebook.
  • Conduct experiments and prepare powerpoint slides for internal presentations as required.
  • Write standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documents for methods, instruments, or work processes as required.
  • Collaborate as needed with internal partners in other functional areas, external vendors, and external scientific partners.
  • Comply with the company safety policies and minimize risk to self, others, and the environment, consistent with the community and industry standards.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • BS with 4+ years or MS with 2+ years relevant experience. Degree should be in Immunology, Biotechnology, Virology, Biochemistry or related field.
  • Hands-on expertise with multi-parameter flow cytometry (minimum 10-color panels) and/or cell sorting .
  • Demonstrated experience with intracellular cytokine staining in preclinical and/ or human PBMC samples and/or ability to execute sterile sorts, optimize sort gates, and troubleshoot sorter performance.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
  • Proficiency in flow cytometry data analysis software (OMIQ preferred)
  • Working knowledge with Good Research Practice (GRP).
  • Ability to expresses one’s self clearly and concisely within team.
  • Good time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work in agile team environment.
  • Attention to details.
  • Data review
  • Training
  • Scheduling
  • GDP
  • GRP, compliance requirements for clinical trial samples.

job.description:

The Change resource is responsible for working as part of the Change Team to implement and manage change activities (including Training) within the project to ensure successful business adoption of new technologies and operating model.
This role involves working closely with stakeholders and Change team members to assess change impacts, execute change management interventions, and support employees through communication, training, and engagement activities. Key Responsibilities:

job.title: Camera Image Quality, Driver Development, and Characterization Engineer
job.description:
Camera Image Quality, Driver Development, and Characterization Engineer
We are seeking an engineer to support camera image quality (IQ) evaluation, driver development, and characterization for advanced vehicle camera systems. This role will execute laboratory and real-world testing, develop test methodologies, analyze data, and communicate findings to camera engineering stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines camera and optical testing experience with Python-based automation and embedded C/C++ development.

Scope:
• Execute camera image quality, characterization, and performance testing in laboratory and real-world environments.
• Develop, maintain, and operate camera IQ test benches, measurement systems, and supporting equipment.
• Create and improve test software for automated data acquisition, analysis, and visualization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods and communicate results, trends, and recommendations.
• Write technical reports documenting characterization results, issues, and recommended actions.
• Develop new test setups and methodologies to expand camera validation capabilities.
• Design, implement, and maintain C/C++ device drivers for automotive CMOS image sensors and video-capture hardware.
• Develop and optimize drivers for multi-gigabit automotive SerDes links, including GMSL2/GMSL3.
• Implement and debug communications across MIPI CSI-2, I2C, Automotive Ethernet, and related interfaces.
• Support camera module bring-up using bench setups, frame grabbers, and diagnostic tools.
• Develop bus-transaction logging utilities, Built-In Self-Test (BIST) routines, and fault-recovery mechanisms.
• Support development practices aligned with automotive functional-safety requirements, including ISO 26262.

Required:
• 2+ years of embedded software development experience using modern C++ and C in Linux or RTOS environments.
• Hands-on experience developing low-level device drivers for image sensors, video-capture hardware, or high-speed peripherals.
• Experience with camera image quality, image sensors, electronics, or imaging systems.
• Experience creating, maintaining, and operating sensitive laboratory measurement setups.
• Proficiency with Python or similar tools for test automation, data acquisition, and analysis.
• Knowledge of CMOS image sensor architecture, basic analog circuits, electronics, and camera system design.
• Experience with imaging lab equipment such as light sources, lux meters, test charts, lenses, optical filters, and opto-mechanical components.
• Understanding of statistical analysis, including variation, uncertainty, and measures of central tendency.
• Strong problem-solving, technical documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
• Ability to work independently with limited supervision while maintaining a clean and professional lab environment.

Pluses:
• Direct experience with automotive multi-gigabit SerDes architectures, including GMSL2 or GMSL3.
• Experience with Automotive Ethernet, including 100BASE-T1 or 1000BASE-T1.
• Experience with high-throughput network-streaming pipelines.
• Experience developing BIST, diagnostics, logging, or fault-recovery systems.
• Experience applying ISO 26262 or other automotive functional-safety standards.
• Experience with Excel, COM-capable programming environments, or statistical software.

Estimated Max Rate: $80.00/hr +. Depends on work experience.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Tech
job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $23.00 to $25.00/Hr.

Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.

Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.

  • Electronic Measurement Devices

  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials

  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
Compliance Materials and Document Logistics Coordinator
We are seeking a detail-oriented coordinator to support materials intake, document printing, filing, and delivery activities. This role will organize incoming vehicle compliance materials, maintain accurate records, prepare documents for distribution, and coordinate deliveries to Waymo depots and offices, FedEx, and other locations as needed.
 
Scope:
• Receive, inspect, and organize incoming materials and documentation.
• Print, prepare, label, and file documents according to established procedures.
• Maintain accurate physical and digital filing systems.
• Track materials, documents, shipments, and delivery status.
• Update electronic trackers and share communications to reflect the latest materials status.
• Prepare packages and materials for depot delivery, including locations such as Waymo's depots.
• Coordinate FedEx shipments and other deliveries as required.

job.title: Manufacturing Technician / Cyclotron Operator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring Manufacturing Technicians / Cyclotron Operators for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

This is an onsite, contract-to-hire opportunity with multiple openings. The team is moving quickly and is looking for candidates with hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, military electronics, industrial electronics, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, biomedical equipment, field service, controls, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience. Prior cyclotron or radiopharmaceutical experience is not required. Training is provided. Candidates must have strong hands-on technical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, reliability, and the ability to learn highly specialized equipment systems in a regulated manufacturing environment. Candidates with general electrical, mechanical, maintenance, manufacturing, or field service backgrounds may be considered if they also have direct experience troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems, automation, controls, circuit-level issues, diagnostic equipment, or complex electro-mechanical equipment.

Pay Rate: $25/hr

Schedule:
  • This is a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Current schedule is 12-hour shifts, 7 days on / 7 days off.
  • Current rotation starts Tuesday and runs through Monday.
  • Quarterly rotation between day shift and night shift required.
  • Overtime pay applies as part of this schedule.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Perform troubleshooting for cyclotron operations and support equipment.
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs of cyclotrons and support equipment.
  • Support advanced maintenance and repair activities under general direction.
  • Perform scheduled start-ups and shutdowns of cyclotrons.
  • Perform target loading, installation, and transport activities.
  • Operate and monitor cyclotrons and support systems during target irradiation.
  • Monitor cyclotrons and support systems during standby conditions.
  • Document cyclotron performance, operations data, maintenance activities, and repair work.
  • Work closely with Cyclotron Chemistry and production teams to support daily production activities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory and quality standards, including FDA, cGMP, NRC, ISO, USP, and related requirements.

Education / Experience:
  • Two-year degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Technology, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Equivalent electronics, automation, military electronics, field service, or hands-on technical training may be considered.
  • Hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, controls, industrial electronics, biomedical equipment, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, field service, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience required.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, meters, schematics, service manuals, troubleshooting procedures, or test equipment preferred.
  • Experience with circuit boards, power supplies, sensors, relays, motors, control systems, automation systems, electrical cabinets, or complex equipment diagnostics preferred.
  • Experience with PLCs, logic circuits, VFDs, RF systems, high-voltage equipment, analog/digital circuits, vacuum systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, or manufacturing equipment is a plus.
  • Experience with component-level electronics troubleshooting, soldering, bench testing, or circuit board repair is strongly preferred but not required.
  • Experience working around ionizing radiation sources is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical systems across multiple equipment areas.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures, document work accurately, and complete extensive on-the-job and compliance training.
  • Strong reliability, communication, safety awareness, and team orientation required.

Strong Fit Backgrounds May Include:
  • Electronics Technician
  • Mechatronics Technician
  • Automation Technician
  • Controls Technician
  • Electromechanical Technician
  • Avionics Technician
  • Military Electronics Technician
  • RF / Radar / Communications Technician
  • Biomedical Equipment Technician
  • Semiconductor Equipment Technician
  • Industrial Electronics Technician
  • Complex Field Service Technician
  • Technical Test Technician
  • CNC Equipment Repair Technician
  • EV / Automotive Electrical Diagnostic Technician

job.title: Trading & Onboarding Consultant
job.description:
Trading & Onboarding Consultant
Fort Mill, SC; Tempe, AZ; San Diego, CA (Hybrid)
6+ month contract
 
Job Overview:
The role will assist with advisor onboarding, platform training, conversion-data review, inbound support, post-conversion issue resolution, and updates to advisor guides and training materials. Successful candidates will be comfortable learning detailed trading workflows, communicating with financial professionals, researching issues, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provide support related to model management, model assignments, restrictions, equivalents, portfolio rebalancing, and block trading workflows.
  • Assist with platform training through webinars, demonstrations, office hours, scheduled appointments, and inbound calls.
  • Help users understand documented differences between systems and workflows.
  • Review available conversion information to identify missing models, assignments, restrictions, equivalents, or other setup issues.
  • Research and document advisor, account, model, and system-related questions.
  • Escalate complex discrepancies or potentially broader conversion issues to the appropriate business or technology partner.
  • Help update job aids, FAQs, training materials, and guides explaining key differences between workflows.
  • Track advisor questions, issue ownership, status, and follow-up through resolution.
  • Support system testing, defect tracking, and post-conversion stabilization activities.
  • Maintain working knowledge of investment products, trading systems, model-based practices, and rebalancing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with Trading, Technology, Product, Operations, Training, and conversion partners.
  • Support additional trading and operational priorities as conversion demand changes.
  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
 
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of financial services or trading operations
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-service, support, operations, or call-center environment Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to explain technical or operational information clearly
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through
  • Ability to research information across multiple systems or data sources
  • Ability to learn new platforms and workflows quickly
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with limited direction
  • Sound judgment when identifying and escalating issues
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • Advisor service and relationship support
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Clear communication
  • Process discipline and follow-through
  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn
  • Issue ownership and escalation
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • FINRA Series 7 strongly preferred
  • Financial-services, trading, or investment-operations experience
  • Knowledge of mutual funds, equities, ETFs, or options
  • Experience with model-based portfolio management or rebalancing
  • Experience supporting models, restrictions, equivalents, or trading instructions
  • Experience providing advisor or client support by phone
  • Experience supporting onboarding, training, conversions, acquisitions, or technology implementations
  • Experience with data review, reconciliation, QA/UAT testing, or issue tracking
  • Experience with ClientWorks Rebalancer, Advisor360, BETA, Model Hub, or similar trading and portfolio-management platforms

job.title: Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager to join our Retail client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of hands-on Shopify Plus experience with a strong technical background in Shopify development, systems integrations, and high-volume e-commerce environments. This individual should live within a commutable distance to Northridge, CA and be comfortable working onsite 5 days per week.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Shopify E-Commerce Manager
Compensation: $120,000–$160,000/year
Type: Full-Time
Industry: Retail

Overview We are seeking a hands-on Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager to support the development, integration, optimization, and ongoing performance of a high-volume Shopify Plus environment.

This role will work across e-commerce, technology, and operations, with responsibility for Shopify development, platform integrations, troubleshooting, and supporting frequent product launches. The ideal candidate combines strong Shopify technical expertise with the ability to work across multiple business systems and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage, maintain, and enhance Shopify Plus storefront functionality
  • Develop and maintain custom Shopify functionality, including Shopify Functions
  • Perform hands-on development using Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across Shopify themes, apps, integrations, checkout functionality, and connected systems
  • Support integrations between Shopify and enterprise platforms including ERP, middleware/iPaaS, WMS, 3PL, and international commerce solutions
  • Assist with the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of system integrations and data flows
  • Support new vendor and technology integrations within the e-commerce ecosystem
  • Monitor and improve site performance, stability, and overall functionality
  • Support frequent product launches, promotions, and high-volume e-commerce events
  • Partner cross-functionally with marketing, design, operations, and technical stakeholders
  • Document integrations, technical processes, fixes, and platform improvements
  • Evaluate Shopify platform updates and new functionality that may benefit the business
  • Support international e-commerce operations and third-party logistics integrations
Technical Focus Areas
  • Shopify Plus development and administration
  • Shopify Functions
  • Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Shopify apps and custom integrations
  • ERP and order-management integrations
  • Middleware / iPaaS platforms such as Celigo or similar
  • NetSuite or comparable ERP platforms
  • WMS and fulfillment system integrations
  • 3PL integrations
  • International commerce platforms such as Global-e or similar
  • Website performance and platform stability
  • API and systems troubleshooting
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of relevant Shopify / Shopify Plus experience
  • Strong hands-on experience developing and supporting Shopify Plus environments
  • Experience working with Shopify Functions
  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Experience integrating Shopify with ERP, WMS, middleware, 3PL, or other enterprise systems
  • Experience with NetSuite, Celigo, or comparable platforms strongly preferred
  • WMS integration experience strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting high-volume DTC or retail e-commerce environments
  • Experience supporting frequent product drops, launches, and rapidly changing business priorities
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across interconnected systems
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical issues from identification through resolution
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can shift quickly
  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred
  • Ability to work onsite in Northridge, CA, 5 days per week
Nice to Have
  • Experience in fashion, apparel, consumer retail, or another high-volume DTC environment
  • Experience with international e-commerce and cross-border commerce platforms
  • Experience with WMS implementations or integrations
  • Experience onboarding and integrating new technology vendors

job.description:
Fiber Field Technician

Join a dynamic team and play a vital role in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of cutting-edge fiber optic networks in the IL Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Peru and Lasalle areas. As a Fiber Field Technician, you will be the frontline hero ensuring seamless connectivity, supporting both wholesale and enterprise customers. This role offers competitive pay, shift premiums, on-call pay, company vehicle, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact in the telecommunications industry.

Required Skills:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a telecommunications environment or equivalent technical training
  • Expertise in DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM installation and maintenance
  • Strong understanding of IP/MPLS fundamentals
  • Proficiency with test equipment such as OTDR, OSA, DS1/3, and Ethernet testing tools
  • Ability to analyze, monitor, and resolve network issues promptly
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making skills
  • Excellent PC skills and strong oral and written communication
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Cisco or Alcatel Lucent IP certifications
  • Experience with VOIP switching and maintenance
  • Fiber optics splicing and maintenance knowledge
  • SS7/STP support experience
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • College or technical degree in related field or equivalent experience
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to work day, evening, night shifts, overtime, call-ins, weekends, and holidays as needed
  • Ability to work in demanding environments and multi-task effectively
Ready to be a key contributor in a fast-paced telecommunications setting? If you’re driven, skilled, and eager to advance your career, we want to hear from you—apply today and help us keep the world connected!


Preferred Locations:  Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Dixon area
