job.title: Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer
job.description:
Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer

The Motion Controls Systems Engineer will participate in the system level design activities for the propulsion and braking system, with a special focus on the electrical and controls integration to the rest of the vehicle system. You will Conceptualize, Design, Engineer, Develop and support the launch of next generation vehicle platform architectures for electric vehicles.

Responsabilities:
  • Participate in vehicle systems and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.
  • Distill product-level requirements and decompose them from vehicle-level motion features down to ECU/software-component functional requirements.
  • Define braking and propulsion functions and work with the hardware, software, architecture, safety and other cross-functional teams to deliver said functionality.
  • Participate in functional safety and failure avoidance analysis of complex electrical and software vehicle subsystems (HARA, FMEAs, etc.).
  • Develop and own motion related vehicle features (drive modes, terrain modes, vehicle hold, speedometer, odometer, cruise control, brake assistance, etc.).
  • Define diagnostic interfaces (DTCs, health monitoring, driver notifications, etc.) relating to the propulsion and braking systems.
  • Build the feature implementation strategy and develop functional boundary diagrams, sequence diagrams, define feature attributes, assess homologation requirements, and other deliverables.
  • Define system level test plans for hardware and software features (virtualized testing environments, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), etc.).
  • Use field data to improve design and performance of the system.
  • Report features development progress and maturity at various program milestones.
  • Participate in architectural and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.

The minimum requirements we seek:
  • BS in Engineering degree in an equivalent field, or equivalent experience.
  • 0-5+ years of experience in systems design, systems architecture, propulsion or brakes systems, integration, and test validation.
  • Strong electrical and systems engineering fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of systems development, vehicle architecture, propulsion technologies, brake system technologies, software/hardware tool development.
  • A systems approach to design and development with the desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement.

Should have experience with some of the following:
  • Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)
  • Traction Control
  • Stability Control
  • Friction & Regen Brake Blending
  • Trailer Brake Controls
  • Hydraulic brake boost assist
  • One-Pedal Driving
  • Hill-start assist
  • Brake torque vectoring
  • Brake Pedal Override
  • Automatic Emergency Braking / Pre-Collision Assistance
  • Dynamic Braking  / Dynamic Deceleration
  • Electronic Park Brake Control features
  • Hydraulic brake boost Control features
  • ESC control features

Preferred Requirements:
  • M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechanical engineering.
  • Proven technical expertise in Propulsion and/or Brakes Systems Design and understanding of the intricacies of the subsystem.
  • Experience in the test, validation, and calibration of vehicle motion control features (e.g., longitudinal/lateral dynamics, regenerative braking, traction control) using HIL/SIL or in-vehicle testing.
  • Experience with electric machine design and DC/AC inverter design.
  • Experience with smart actuators, brake-by-wire systems, and integrated motion controllers.
  • Experience with Vehicle Network Protocols such as CAN, LIN & Automotive Ethernet.
  • Experience in leading product development from concept to deployment.
  • Experience in MATLAB, Python, or equivalent tools for modeling and analysis.
  • Experience operating within an Agile software development framework utilizing modern CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and software deployment.
  • Proficiency in fundamentals of vehicle architecture, embedded systems design, RTOS’s and real-time networking.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety standards (industry certification is highly preferred).

Estimated Max Rate: $90.00

job.title: Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
job.description:
Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Job Overview
The Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer will participate in the overall management and end-user support of the organization’s Messaging and SaaS offerings.
This position will primarily provide support to the end-user population for Exchange Online, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Box, including Microsoft 365 account and license administration. Experience with additional Microsoft 365 components is a plus.
 
The ideal candidate is a customer-focused support professional with strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, and the ability to work effectively across teams in a complex enterprise environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide Tier 2 end-user support for Messaging and SaaS-based tools, including:
    • Exchange Online
    • Microsoft Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Microsoft OneDrive
    • Box
  • Support Microsoft 365 account and license administration
  • Apply and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams policies
  • Perform mailbox maintenance and access management
  • Support message archiving, retrieval, and deletion
  • Troubleshoot end-user collaboration and messaging issues
  • Create and maintain process and environment documentation
  • Support and develop ServiceNow ticket automation
  • Create and modify PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Partner with other technical teams to resolve complex infrastructure and application issues
  • Participate in on-call support rotations
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience providing end-user support for Microsoft applications, specifically:
    • Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
  • 2+ years of experience with basic Box administration and end-user troubleshooting
  • 1–2 years of experience working with ServiceNow
  • 1–2 years of experience administering and supporting OneDrive
  • 1+ year of experience creating and modifying PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Experience supporting Exchange Online
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 account and licensing administration
  • Experience with mailbox and access management
  • Exposure to additional Microsoft 365 technologies
  • Relevant and current technical certifications
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues involving multiple technical teams
  • Desire to learn and support emerging cloud technologies
  • Hands-on experience working within complex enterprise infrastructure environments
  • Experience within a highly regulated industry
  • Previous participation in an on-call support rotation

job.title: Nurse Practitioner - Occupational Health
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner needed for a contract opportunity with our occupational health clinic located in Hagerstown, MD. This is an occupational health clinic within an automotive facility.   
 
Schedule: M-F 3p-11p
Duration: 7/24-9/4 with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $65-80/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs physical examinations and preventive health measures within prescribed guidelines and instructions of Physician.
  • Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify and assess patients’ clinical problems and health care needs.
  • Records physical findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient’s condition. Provides written home-going instructions.
  • Collaborates with Physician and other health professionals to prepare comprehensive patient care plan as necessary.
  • Prescribes or recommends medications or other forms of treatment such as physical therapy, inhalation therapy, or related therapeutic procedures.
  • Refers patients to Physician for consultation or to specialized health resources for treatment.
  • Maintains medical records using (In some health centers it may be using Electronic Medical Record software).

  • All NP licenses and education to practice
  • Current BLS certification
  • Occ Health experience preferred but open to candidates with related experience
  • DOT certification a plus

job.title: Human Resources Operations Partner
job.description:
Human Resources Operations Partner
Position Overview We are seeking an organized and motivated People Business Partner to provide hands-on support across People Operations, annual talent programs, reporting, and HR process improvement initiatives. This position is execution-focused and ideal for an early-to-mid-career HR professional who enjoys managing data, coordinating multiple projects, and supporting performance and compensation processes.

The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable working in Workday, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement: Remote or hybrid based on proximity to an office
Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours per week
Contract Duration: 6–12 months with potential for extension or conversion

Key Responsibilities Support annual HR processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.

  • Enter and complete HR transactions in Workday.
  • Pull, review, and analyze Workday reports and employee data.
  • Conduct data audits and maintain accuracy during performance, compensation, and talent cycles.

job.title: Research Engineer – Transportation
job.description:
Research Engineer – Transportation (Thermoplastics & Product Commercialization) Join a collaborative, highly technical team focused on bringing next-generation polymer-based materials to market across North American transportation segments. In this role, you’ll lead development programs that take thermoplastic compounds and masterbatches from concept through scale-up and commercialization—partnering closely with customers and cross-functional teams to solve real performance challenges and deliver differentiated, production-ready solutions. This is a fully onsite position, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on strategic growth priorities in transportation markets.

Required Skills
  • Proven experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer-based compounds and/or masterbatches (aerospace high-performance polymer development experience is also relevant)
  • Ability to support R&D from concept development through commercialization, including scale-up and manufacturing support
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of polymer processing, compounding, and formulation development
  • Understanding of thermoplastics manufacturing processes and automation
  • Working knowledge of DOE (Design of Experiments), statistical analysis, and data-driven product development
  • Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills (internal teams and customers)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and drive timelines, deliverables, and quality expectations
Nice to Have Skills
  • Experience with engineering thermoplastics, polyolefins, and twin-screw extrusion
  • Background in transportation material qualification
  • Familiarity with automotive and/or aerospace OEM specifications
  • Experience with weatherable materials, flame-retardant systems, and/or color-critical applications
  • Exposure to stage-gate or structured innovation/product development systems
  • Interest or experience integrating sustainability targets (e.g., recyclability, bio-based content, durability)
Preferred Education and Experience
  • M.S. preferred in Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field (Ph.D. or advanced degree also valued)
  • Bachelor’s degree considered with strong, hands-on industry experience
  • 5+ years of experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer compounds/masterbatches for transportation markets (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense, recreational, utility vehicles)
Bring your formulation expertise and commercialization mindset to a role built for real ownership—apply today to help deliver the next wave of transportation materials from lab to market.

job.title: Optical Mech Technician
job.description:
Optical Technician 

Planet is seeking a highly skilled Contract Optical Technician to support the integration and testing of optical payloads for the Pelican satellite program. This role is focused on the tactical execution of telescope and camera assembly, alignment, and characterization. We are looking for a precision-oriented technician who excels in a cleanroom environment and has a proven track record of handling delicate flight optics and complex opto-mechanical assemblies. 

Impact You’ll Own 

  • Payload Integration and Assembly: Execute the high-precision assembly of telescopes and focal plane arrays, including the delicate bonding of optics using RTV and aerospace-grade epoxies. 

  • Optical Characterization: Perform ground-based testing of cameras and telescopes for image quality, MTF, and radiometric performance following established test procedures. 

  • Precision Metrology: Utilize and maintain optical test stations, including the use of interferometers, wavefront sensors, collimators, and integrating spheres to ensure payload performance. 

  • Fixture Assembly: Build and maintain opto-mechanical and electrical test fixtures to support the high-volume production and verification of Pelican payloads. 

  • Data Recording: Meticulously record test results and prepare data summaries for engineering review, ensuring all anomalies are captured and reported via Jira or in-house software. 

  • Component Handling: Proficiently handle, measure, and clean sensitive optical components according to strict cleanroom and laboratory safety protocols. 

  • Collaborative Debugging: Work closely with Manufacturing and Test Engineers to troubleshoot opto-mechanical or electrical failures identified during the build or test cycle. 

What You Bring 

  • Experience: Proven background in optics and optical assemblies, specifically within a high-precision manufacturing or aerospace environment. 

  • High-Reliability Bonding: Professional experience with the precision application of RTV and epoxies for mounting and securing optical elements. 

  • Alignment Expertise: Solid understanding of optical alignment techniques and the use of metrology equipment to verify image quality metrics. 

  • Laboratory Discipline: A methodical approach to following complex, detailed test procedures exactly as written, with no unauthorized deviations. 

  • Mechanical Aptitude: Proficiency with mechanical tools, fixtures, and the ability to read and interpret both mechanical and electrical drawings/schematics. 

  • Documentation Accuracy: Impeccable organizational skills with a focus on recording accurate, detailed test descriptions and data manipulation. 

  • Hardware Sensitivity: Extreme care when handling flight-critical optics and a deep understanding of ESD-safe and cleanroom best practices. 

What Makes You Stand Out 

  • Educational Background: Degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 

  • Spacecraft Payload Experience: Previous experience working on satellite telescopes, focal planes, or mission-critical camera systems. 

  • Advanced Debugging: Ability to perform root-cause analysis on complex opto-mechanical systems and electrical cable/harness assemblies. 

  • Software Familiarity: Basic experience with Python or lab automation tools to assist in data collection and test station operation. 

  • Soldering Proficiency: Experience with PCB soldering and the assembly of delicate electronics associated with optical sensors.

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Supplier Quality Engineer to join our aerospace and defense technology client. This opportunity is ideal for candidates who are within a commutable distance to Irvine, CA and are open to an onsite work environment with significant travel requirements.
See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP. Title: Supplier Quality Engineer
Compensation: $100k - $128k base + bonus (base salary depends on experience)
Type: Direct Hire
Industry: Aerospace / Defense Technology
Eligibility: Must be a US Person (ITAR environment) Responsibilities
  • Partner with internal teams and external suppliers to evaluate, monitor, and improve supplier quality performance.
  • Lead resolution of supplier-related nonconformances to prevent production disruptions and customer impact.
  • Drive root cause investigations and corrective action processes, ensuring timely and effective closure.
  • Review and approve supplier corrective action responses, prioritizing based on business and operational impact.
  • Identify supplier risks related to product quality or safety and escalate appropriately.
  • Support supplier development initiatives, including training and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Act as a technical expert for supplier-related quality concerns and provide guidance on complex issues.
  • Analyze supplier performance data and recommend process or product improvements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams on quality initiatives.
  • Participate in audits and ensure supplier compliance with applicable industry standards.
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support quality and operational goals.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field).
  • 10+ years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or related engineering discipline.
  • Strong background in root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies (e.g., 8D, A3).
  • Experience with quality systems and tools such as PFMEA, control plans, DOE, Lean, and Six Sigma.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and engineering documentation (including GD&T).
  • Familiarity with aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100, AS9110, AS9120) and inspection practices.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Minitab, or similar).
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP is a plus.
  • Knowledge of APQP or advanced product quality planning processes is preferred.
  • Prior auditing experience and/or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development practices.
Additional Requirements
  • Valid driver’s license with ability to travel frequently (up to 50%, domestic and international).
  • Passport required; must be comfortable with short-notice travel.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional or remote teams on complex initiatives.
Soft Skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels.
  • Effective problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to influence without authority and drive continuous improvement.
  • Conflict resolution skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence.
Work Environment / Physical Requirements
  • Primarily office-based with occasional interaction in lab or production settings.
  • Regular computer use and standard office equipment operation.
  • Ability to occasionally lift light items (up to 10 lbs).
  • Must be able to observe and assess detailed components at close range.
If you are interested in this opportunity or similar roles, please apply today with your most recent resume.

job.title: Scientist - Process Sciences
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Scientist I, Process Sciences to support the development and optimization of solid-phase reactor processes. This role is focused on applying chemical and process engineering principles to solid-phase reaction systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of fluid flow, mass transfer, pressure drop, mixing, resin/solid-support behavior, reaction kinetics, and process scale-up.

This is an onsite position based in Cambridge, MA.

Position: Scientist, Process Sciences
Rate: $40–$55/hr DOE
Location: Cambridge, MA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute laboratory experiments supporting solid-phase reactor development and optimization.
  • Evaluate reactor performance, including fluid flow, pressure drop, mass transfer, mixing, residence time, and solid loading.
  • Investigate the impact of resin/solid-support properties such as swelling, packing, permeability, and particle behavior on process performance.
  • Apply reaction engineering and chemical engineering principles to troubleshoot reactor and process limitations.
  • Analyze experimental data and identify relationships between hydrodynamics, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, and process performance.
  • Support process development and scale-up of solid-phase reactor systems.
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, analytical teams, and equipment partners.
  • Document experimental results and contribute to technical reports, protocols, and presentations.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, Polymer Science, or a related discipline or M.S. with 3+ years of relevant industry or research experience.
  • Hands-on experience with chemical process development, reactor systems, reaction engineering, or solid-liquid processing.
  • Strong understanding of fluid flow, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, and process engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience designing experiments, analyzing quantitative data, and troubleshooting experimental systems.
  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
Preferred Experience:
  • Packed-bed or fluidized-bed reactors
  • Solid-phase or heterogeneous reaction systems
  • Reactor hydrodynamics and pressure-drop analysis
  • Mass-transfer studies
  • Resin, polymer, or solid-support systems
  • Chromatography or packed-column operations
  • Catalysis
  • Peptide or solid-phase synthesis
  • Oligonucleotide synthesis
  • Process scale-up and technology transfer
  • Design of Experiments (DoE)
We're looking for a hands-on scientist or engineer who understands how a solid-phase reactor actually works and can connect fundamental engineering principles to real-world process performance. Strong candidates from adjacent chemical and process engineering environments are encouraged to apply.



 #IND-SPG

job.title: Data Center BA
job.description:
Data Center Business Analyst
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Onsite) – onsite interview required
 
Position Summary
The Data Center Business Analyst will support Data Center Projects and Operations by gathering and documenting business and technical requirements, managing project documentation, tracking financials and KPIs, creating JIRA stories, and supporting operational analysis. This role will work closely with Project Managers, Operations, Facilities, Engineering Teams, and functional stakeholders to improve processes, drive project execution, and support operational resilience initiatives, including disaster recovery and Black Start planning.
 
Responsibilities
  • Gather, analyze, and document business, technical, and non-functional requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, process flows, MOPs, and release plans.
  • Support project planning, scope management, scheduling, and status reporting.
  • Create and manage JIRA stories, tasks, and action items.
  • Maintain documentation within Confluence and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI metrics to support operational and project decision-making.
  • Analyze current processes and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
  • Support Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools and reporting.
  • Assist with project financial tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Black Start readiness activities, including recovery documentation, dependency mapping, and tabletop exercises.
  • Prepare meeting minutes, track follow-up actions, and coordinate with stakeholders across multiple teams.
  • Travel to data center facilities as required.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of Business Analyst experience supporting Data Center, Infrastructure, or Technology projects.
  • Experience working with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.
  • Strong knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating them into technical deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

job.title: Migration Engineer
job.description:
Migration Engineer
12 month contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Job Overview
The Migration Engineer will support a high volume of acquisition-related integration work, with a primary focus on planning, designing, and executing large-scale email and data migrations while minimizing disruption to users and business operations.
This role will support the migration of email into Exchange Online and assist with data migrations from external sources into a centralized Box environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise across enterprise messaging platforms, internet email systems, DNS, email security, migration tooling, and troubleshooting.
 
David is looking for someone who has demonstrated success delivering complex migrations and who can partner effectively with both technical and business stakeholders throughout the migration lifecycle.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Assist with the migration of mailboxes from multiple external sources into one or more managed Exchange Online tenants
  • Support the planning and execution of migration activities while minimizing disruption to users and business operations
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, internal teams, and external partners to assess current mailbox configurations and migration requirements
  • Provide escalation support to end users during migrations and address issues promptly
  • Document migration procedures, configurations, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned
  • Assist the Data Migration team with moving data from external sources into a centralized, managed Box environment
  • Support troubleshooting across migration tools, email platforms, end-user clients, and related infrastructure
  • Communicate technical migration steps and issues in clear business terms to non-technical stakeholders
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent IT work experience
  • 3+ years of relevant IT experience
  • 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Exchange Online, including migrations
  • 3+ years of experience with Proofpoint Email Protection
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DKIM
    • SPF
    • DMARC
    • Internet email systems
    • DNS
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting
  • Experience using BitTitan MigrationWiz for mailbox migrations to Exchange Online
  • Extensive experience configuring and troubleshooting:
    • Microsoft Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
  • Experience supporting end-user clients across:
    • Windows
    • macOS
    • iOS
    • Android
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain technical procedures in business terms to non-technical stakeholders
  • Hands-on software and hardware troubleshooting experience
  • Experience with Box migration tools
  • Strong analytical and methodical troubleshooting skills

The ideal candidate brings hands-on Veeva PromoMats and MedComms experience along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions within a regulated environment.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: IT System Analyst– Veeva PromoMats & MedComms
Location: Princeton, NJ (Hybrid)
Compensation: $145,000–$155,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications
Type: Full-Time / Direct Hire
 
**This role is not able to provide sponsorship. Candidates must be able to work on our clients W2 without sponsorship now or in the future**

Responsibilities
  • Support the administration, maintenance, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of Veeva PromoMats and MedComms applications.
  • Partner with Medical, Commercial, IT, and other business stakeholders to gather requirements and improve content review and approval processes.
  • Configure and optimize workflows supporting medical, legal, and regulatory review activities across multiple business groups and markets.

job.title: Soldering Technician
job.description:
About the Role: Solder Technician 

You will be joining a world-class Satellite Manufacturing team. Currently, our production demands require a highly skilled Contract Solder Technician to take ownership of specialized, high-complexity assembly tasks. 

This role is designed for a technical expert who can hit the ground running, relieving pressure on our core team by independently managing high-volume production of intricate components. You will work with in-house custom jigs and specialized flight hardware where precision is the only acceptable standard. 

Impact You’ll Own: 

  • Specialized Flight Assembly: Take full ownership of complex soldering tasks, including torque rod assemblies and delicate battery tab interconnects. 

  • High-Volume Execution: Independently perform precision rework and assembly on a high volume of PCBAs daily. 

  • Jig-Based Precision: Use and maintain in-house custom fixtures/jigs to ensure repeatable, high-reliability solder joints on non-standard components. 

  • Precision Rework: Expertly add/remove components, install switches, and attach shields to boards using a microscope. 

  • Workflow Management: Use in-house software to track work progress and maintain digital records of throughput. 

  • Operational Excellence: Organize physical hardware on trays systematically and manage a shifting queue of priorities without constant supervision. 

What You Bring: 

  • Specific Mastery: Proven experience soldering torque rods, magnetics, or high-current battery tabs (highly preferred). 

  • Daily Precision Experience: A career background where high-reliability soldering under a microscope was the primary daily function, not a secondary task. 

  • Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and utilize proprietary in-house jigs and tooling for complex mechanical-to-electrical interfaces. 

  • Independent Drive: Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain high productivity in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with electronic part numbering systems and the ability to read complex drawings/schematics. 

  • Certification: IPC-A-610 or J-STD-001 (Active or recently expired). 

What Makes You Stand Out: 

  • NASA 8739.3/.2 or J-STD-001 Space Addendum certification. 

  • Experience with BGA rework stations and X-ray inspection. 

  • Previous experience in Aerospace or Medical Device manufacturing. 

  • Experience with wire-to-tab bonding or high-vibration environment assembly.

As the Compliance Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the company adheres to regulatory standards and customer requirements through audits, policy development, and risk mitigation strategies. job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Process Engineer – Critical Minerals in Houston, TX. This role will be a responsible for improving process recovery, product purity, throughput, and reagent efficiency. Support successful pilot testing and technology deployment across variable brine chemistries. The Process Engineer should have iodine recovery and brine processing experience. 
 
Title: Process Engineer- Critical Minerals
Duration: Contract/DH
Pay: $70/hr
Location: Houston, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Position Summary The Process Engineer will support the development, optimization, scale-up, and deployment of brine-processing systems. This individual will work across engineering, chemistry, operations, vendors, and customer sites to convert emerging separation technologies into repeatable pilot and commercial processes.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between engineering calculations, pilot equipment, process documentation, field troubleshooting, and hands-on problem solving.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and optimize process flowsheets for brine, produced-water, iodine, and lithium recovery systems.
  • Translate laboratory and bench-scale results into pilot, demonstration, and commercial process designs.
  • Prepare and maintain process flow diagrams, P&IDs, equipment specifications, operating procedures, and process documentation.
  • Perform mass and energy balances, process calculations, equipment sizing, and operating-envelope development.
  • Support the design, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and operation of pilot and demonstration systems.
  • Evaluate unit operations such as adsorption, ion exchange, membranes, solvent extraction, filtration, precipitation, concentration, and purification.
  • Troubleshoot process, mechanical, instrumentation, and equipment issues during pilot and field operations.
  • Track recovery, purity, throughput, reagent consumption, water quality, waste generation, and other key performance indicators.
  • Develop sampling plans and collaborate with analytical teams to interpret brine and product-quality data.
  • Support design reviews, HAZID/HAZOP activities, process safety assessments, and management-of-change processes.
  • Work with equipment suppliers, contract engineering firms, EPC partners, and customer-site stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recovery, selectivity, reliability, operating cost, and system scalability.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, recommendations, and project status to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Travel periodically to pilot facilities, customer sites, vendors, and project locations.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Minerals Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in process engineering, process development, pilot operations, hydrometallurgy, water treatment, chemical processing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience developing, operating, troubleshooting, or scaling chemical or separation processes.
  • Working knowledge of mass balances, process calculations, equipment sizing, and process optimization.
  • Ability to read and develop PFDs and P&IDs.
  • Experience working with pumps, tanks, piping, valves, filtration, membranes, chemical dosing, or related process equipment.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work hands-on in a fast-moving startup environment with changing priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with lithium extraction, iodine recovery, critical minerals, hydrometallurgy, or produced-water treatment.
  • Experience with solvent extraction, liquid-liquid extraction, adsorption, ion exchange, membrane separation, or selective recovery.
  • Experience with high-salinity or chemically complex aqueous systems.
  • Pilot-plant, demonstration-scale, commissioning, or field-deployment experience.
  • Familiarity with process simulation, techno-economic analysis, CAPEX/OPEX evaluation, or process modeling.
  • Experience with HAZOP, HAZID, PSM, MOC, or other process-safety practices.
  • Experience working with EPC firms, equipment vendors, contract laboratories, or oil-and-gas operators.
  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering or technical discipline.

job.title: Advanced Semiconductor Materials Planner-Onsite
job.description:
Materials Planner (Advanced Level-Onsite Role)
Location: Austin, Texas
Shift:  (8-hour) Day Shift 8AM-5PM
Duration: 9-Month Contract
Environment: Manufacturing / Warehouse


Pay Rate: $50 to $56 per hour




What You’ll Do:
  • Planner II supports planning, forecasting, and analysis of service parts and product-related requirements to ensure material availability in the right location, in the right quantities, and at the right time.
  • You will operate within a defined planning scope, applying your foundational planning expertise while executing standard planning processes.
  • This role requires a quick learner with a genuine desire to improve, an eagerness to expand their capabilities, and a strong analytical curiosity and critical thinking.
  • As part of the team, you will deliver reliable planning outcomes while thriving in a product lifecycle-based planning organization that values growth, initiative, and a passion for learning.

 Responsibilities: 
  • Planning Execution: Support demand forecasting, inventory planning, and material planning activities within assigned product or lifecycle scope.
  • Execute planning activities using enterprise planning systems to align supply and demand.
  • Support planning deliverables related to NPI readiness, ECO planning, sustaining operations, and transitions.
  • Develop and maintain production, material, and supply schedules to support customer demand and business objectives.
  • Monitor schedule adherence, identify capacity constraints, material shortages, and supply chain risks, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.
  • Coordinate schedule changes resulting from demand fluctuations, engineering changes (ECOs), NPI builds, and supply interruptions while balancing inventory, service, and operational goals. Ensure planning parameters and scheduling data are accurate to support execution, visibility, and on-time delivery performance.

Problem Solving:
  • Perform part shortage analysis, root cause analysis, and basic scenario evaluation.
  • Identify risks related to material availability, service levels, or transitions and escalate with supporting data.
  • Support corrective implementation under established processes and guidance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Business Units, Service Business Units, Operations, Logistics, and Regional Planning partners to resolve planning issues. Act as a planning point-of-contact within defined scope, communicating status and risks clearly and professionally.

 System Discipline:
  • Maintain accuracy of planning data and support adherence to standard planning processes.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to planning tools, processes, and data quality
  • Build understanding of product lifecycle planning concepts and business drivers.
  • Develop planning judgment by understanding downstream impacts of planning decisions.
  • Progress from executing defined plans to identifying risk and proposing improvements.



What You Bring:
  • Bachelor degree from an accredited university; emphasis in Supply Chain or Engineering, Industrial Engineering preferred.
  • 3-7 years of inventory management, supply planning, or demand planning experience (including KPI management).
  • Semiconductor background strongly preferred, especially in Parts, Warranty, or Service.
  • Proficient with ERP/supply chain systems (Oracle, SAP, SPP, or similar).
  • Self-motivated, accountable, strong project management and innovation skills.
  • Excellent analytical ability; proven use of data-driven analysis to develop solutions. Familiar with Tableau, Power BI, SQL. Skilled in interpreting complex data sets to identify trends and issues.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong collaborator with internal teams and customers.
  • Sound business acumen and understanding of key business drivers.
  • Effective problem-solving, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and structed learning.


Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, or other ERP systems- Background in warehouse, inventory, or manufacturing operations
  • Bachelor's Degree
Years of Experience:
  • 4 - 7 Years

Work Environment:
  • Standing/walking for extended periods
  • Lifting, bending, reaching, and working in tight or fast-paced environments
  • Exposure to noise and manufacturing conditions
  • Required use of PPE (safety shoes, glasses, gloves, etc.)

Benefits of Working with Yoh:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Weekly pay with direct deposit
- Yoh referral bonus programs
- Employee discount programs
- Dedicated recruiter support and career guidance
- Opportunities for experience with leading companies and potential conversion

What You’ll Gain:
- Real-world experience in inventory and materials management
- Exposure to ERP systems and supply chain operations
- Skill development in data analysis and process improvement
- A strong foundation for long-term career growth in operations or manufacturing

job.title: Manufacturing Operator
job.description:
Manufacturing Operator - rotating day/night shift schedule 

Location: Marlborough, MA (Onsite)
Pay Rate: $22.00 - $24.50/hour (W-2)
Contract Length: 12 Months
Schedule: Rotating Day & Night Shifts (4 Days On / 4 Days Off)

Yoh Staffing is seeking a Manufacturing Operator for our client in the semiconductor manufacturing industry in Marlborough, MA. This position supports chemical manufacturing operations through batch processing, material handling, packaging, and equipment operation in a plant environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.
Schedule This position follows a rotating schedule of 4 days on, 4 days off, alternating between day and night shifts:
  • Day Shift: 6:45 AM - 7:15 PM
  • Night Shift: 6:45 PM - 7:15 AM
Training Schedule During the first 4 weeks, all new hires will complete training on the day shift:
  • Monday - Thursday
  • 6:45 AM - 5:15 PM
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain a safe work environment and actively participate in safety programs and training.
  • Follow established operating procedures and manufacturing protocols.
  • Perform manufacturing batch processing according to written procedures.
  • Operate, monitor, and inspect process equipment and systems.
  • Receive and execute work assignments from supervisors and team leads.
  • Complete routine production activities, including:
    • Labeling materials
    • Forming and filling boxes
    • Material handling and movement
    • Packaging operations
  • Ensure accurate documentation and attention to quality standards.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors to support production goals.
Qualifications Required
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and safety protocols.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic.
Preferred
  • Experience in a manufacturing, production, or cleanroom environment.
  • Forklift/Fork Truck operating experience.
Physical Requirements
  • Stand and walk for the majority of a 12-hour shift.
  • Occasionally lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Perform bending, pushing, pulling, and reaching activities regularly.
  • Work at table level and overhead level as needed.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise, odors, dust, heat, cold, and chemicals.
  • Required use of designated PPE, which may include:
    • Safety glasses/goggles
    • Gloves
    • Hard hat
    • Respirator
    • Cleanroom garments
  • Work in an electrically classified area where flammable and combustible materials may be present.

job.title: Warehouse Associate – Pharmaceutical Distribution
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Warehouse Associate for a direct-hire opportunity with our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position is ideal for someone with warehouse, distribution, shipping/receiving, inventory, or manufacturing experience who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where accuracy and meeting strict shipping deadlines are critical.

The products handled in this facility are time-sensitive radiopharmaceutical products that are ultimately shipped for patient use. Extensive training is provided, including cGMP, safety, SOP, and radiation-safety training.

Location: Noblesville, IN
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Base Salary: $50,000 annually plus shift differential

Schedule

Initial Training – Approximately 2 Months:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM

Permanent Schedule Following Training:
Saturday–Wednesday, 6:00 AM–2:30 PM
Thursday and Friday off

Candidates must be able to complete the Monday–Friday training period and permanently work the Saturday–Wednesday schedule.

Responsibilities
  • Perform warehouse and distribution activities including receiving, order fulfillment, inventory handling, and cycle counting.
  • Accurately process, fill, package, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures.
  • Prepare products and shipping documentation to meet strict, time-sensitive shipment deadlines.
  • Complete product consolidations based on established flight and shipping schedules.
  • Maintain accurate finished-goods inventory using electronic and paper-based systems.
  • Perform inventory transactions and maintain complete and accurate warehouse records.
  • Handle radiopharmaceutical products in accordance with established safety procedures and training.
  • Follow cGMP requirements, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Complete required documentation and paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, organized, and compliant warehouse environment.
  • Support additional warehouse and distribution activities as assigned.


Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1+ year of warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, shipping/receiving, inventory, fulfillment, or related experience required.
  • Experience with shipping/receiving, cycle counting, inventory control, order fulfillment, packaging, or finished-goods handling preferred.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare distribution, food manufacturing, chemical, or other regulated-industry experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience using computerized warehouse, inventory, or distribution-management systems preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written procedures accurately.
  • Comfortable completing detailed documentation and working within a highly structured environment.
  • Strong reliability, punctuality, and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced distribution environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be comfortable working around radiopharmaceutical products after completing required safety and radiation-safety training.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The successful candidate will be highly dependable, flexible, safety-conscious, and comfortable following detailed procedures. Because these products have limited shelf lives and must ship according to strict schedules for patient use, punctuality, accuracy, and documentation are critical.

job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring an Instrument Services Technician for our life sciences customer in Loveland, CO.  The Instrument Service Technician will provide service to internal and external customers by performing maintenance on, troubleshooting, and repairing designated instrumentation. 

Shift: M-F day shift

Maintenance & Repair: 90% of position responsibility

Education and Experience:
  • Technical Studies/AAS degree in Electronics or related field, or minimum of 3 years’ experience in related field.
  • Biomedical Engineering, veterinary lab, and/or medical technology experience a plus.

  • Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.

Open to working weekend hours

job.title: Lead Endpoint Support Engineer
job.description:
Lead Endpoint Support Engineer
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, engineering, and lifecycle management of desktops, laptops, and mobile endpoints for corporate and branch users.
  • Lead configuration, deployment, and management of endpoints using Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, and application deployment.
  • Manage endpoint security posture using Microsoft Defender, including threat detection, response, and remediation across the device fleet.
  • Evaluate, implement, and manage Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) and virtual desktop solutions to support flexible and remote work needs.
  • Drive standardization of device imaging, patching, and configuration management to improve consistency and reduce support overhead.
  • Lead the endpoint support function, ensuring timely and effective resolution of desktop, laptop, and peripheral issues for corporate headquarters and branch locations.
  • Establish and monitor support SLAs, ticket queues, and escalation paths to drive consistent service delivery across the organization.
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement for recurring endpoint issues to reduce downtime and support volume.
  • Partner with security and infrastructure teams to ensure endpoints are compliant, patched, and aligned with security policy.
  • Manage relationships, contracts, and performance of hardware, software, and DaaS vendors supporting the endpoint environment.
  • Own the endpoint procurement, refresh, and asset lifecycle management process, including budgeting and forecasting for hardware needs.
  • Negotiate vendor agreements and service levels to optimize cost, quality, and support responsiveness.
  • Evaluate new endpoint tools, hardware, and services, and lead vendor selection and onboarding processes.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of endpoint engineers and support technicians across corporate and branch locations.
  • Partner with IT leadership, security, and business stakeholders to align endpoint strategy with business priorities and user needs.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders on endpoint health, security posture, project status, and support performance.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, standards, and training materials for endpoint support processes.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Modern Desktop Administrator, Endpoint Administrator Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., Security+) a plus.
  • 6+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, desktop support, or end user computing, including 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role.
  • Hands-on experience managing endpoints with Microsoft Intune, including device compliance, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for endpoint security, threat detection, and response.
  • Experience evaluating and supporting Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) or virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) solutions.
  • Proven experience supporting a distributed environment with corporate offices and multiple branch or retail locations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendors, contracts, and hardware/software procurement.
  • Experience with Windows OS deployment, imaging, and patch management tools.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team management skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network-related endpoint issues.
  • Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across corporate and branch locations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-service oriented mindset with a focus on end user experience.

job.title: Chemical Operator III
job.description:
Chemical Operator - rotating day/night shift schedule 

Location: Marlborough, MA (Onsite)
Pay Rate: $22.00 - $24.50/hour (W-2)
Contract Length: 12 Months
Schedule: Rotating Day & Night Shifts (4 Days On / 4 Days Off)

Yoh Staffing is seeking a Chemical Operator for our client in the semiconductor manufacturing industry in Marlborough, MA. This position supports chemical manufacturing operations through batch processing, material handling, packaging, and equipment operation in a plant environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.
Schedule This position follows a rotating schedule of 4 days on, 4 days off, alternating between day and night shifts:
  • Day Shift: 6:45 AM - 7:15 PM
  • Night Shift: 6:45 PM - 7:15 AM
Training Schedule During the first 4 weeks, all new hires will complete training on the day shift:
  • Monday - Thursday
  • 6:45 AM - 5:15 PM
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain a safe work environment and actively participate in safety programs and training.
  • Follow established operating procedures and manufacturing protocols.
  • Perform manufacturing batch processing according to written procedures.
  • Operate, monitor, and inspect process equipment and systems.
  • Receive and execute work assignments from supervisors and team leads.
  • Complete routine production activities, including:
    • Labeling materials
    • Forming and filling boxes
    • Material handling and movement
    • Packaging operations
  • Ensure accurate documentation and attention to quality standards.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors to support production goals.
Qualifications Required
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and safety protocols.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic.
Preferred
  • Experience in a manufacturing, production, or cleanroom environment.
  • Forklift/Fork Truck operating experience.
Physical Requirements
  • Stand and walk for the majority of a 12-hour shift.
  • Occasionally lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Perform bending, pushing, pulling, and reaching activities regularly.
  • Work at table level and overhead level as needed.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise, odors, dust, heat, cold, and chemicals.
  • Required use of designated PPE, which may include:
    • Safety glasses/goggles
    • Gloves
    • Hard hat
    • Respirator
    • Cleanroom garments
  • Work in an electrically classified area where flammable and combustible materials may be present.

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.title: Disability Specialist
job.description:
Disability Specialist needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Newark, NJ. This Disability Specialist will work to ensure students with disabilities have the opportunity to fully experience what it means to be part of the University community. They will look to reduce barriers for students in-and-out of the classroom, help students achieve their goals, and be a resource for the campus community.
 
Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 months with possible extension
Pay: $30-45/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Plans, organizes and provides reasonable accommodations that include academic adjustments, auxiliary aids, and services to students with disabilities – physical, psychological, learning, health-related, and neurological disabilities (e.g., mobility impairments, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, learning disorders, hearing impairments, visual impairments, traumatic brain injuries, and epilepsy)
  • Conducts initial interviews with students; keeping accurate, comprehensive and up-to-date notes/records related to students; reviews documentation and evaluative reports; prepares letters of accommodation; evaluating eligibility for services; conducts follow-up meetings with students; organizing reasonable accommodations, services and auxiliary aids for students; and makes referrals to appropriate services or agencies
  • Consults with faculty and staff regarding the implementation of reasonable accommodations and services; develops and presents disability awareness programs for the community
  • Collaborates with other offices and outside agencies, as needed and appropriate
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in one of the related fields: Counselor Education, Special Education, Counseling Psychology, Education, or a related field
  • A minimum of four years’ experience in a disability services office in higher education in one of the related fields: Counselor Education, Special Education, Counseling Psychology, Education, or a related field
  • Certification in Rehabilitation Counseling Education would be beneficial in working with various students served by the office as well as experience in learning disabilities consultation
  • Requires strong computer skills and effective use of various software and hardware programs used in a multi-function disability office including but not limited to:
    • Database systems
    • MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
    • Email and social media tools
    • Accessible technologies and Web 2.0 tools
What’s In It For You?

  • Direct deposit & weekly epayroll

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Material Handler for our manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for pulling, kitting, and restocking raw materials and finished products to support production operations. The Material Handler will operate applicable industrial equipment, maintain clean work areas, comply with written manufacturing procedures, and support production teams in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom environments. This position also supports inventory accuracy, material flow, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Industry: Medical Device
Location: Santa Fe Springs
Compensation: $19 - $21/hr 
Shift: 2:40pm–11:10pm. Mon - Fri
Type: contract-to-hire
 

Job Functions
  • Pull, pick, kit, and restock raw materials and products to support production operations.
  • Work in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom manufacturing environments.
  • Support production teams by ensuring timely and accurate material availability.
  • Work closely with customer service and sales teams in a supporting role, as needed.
  • Understand and follow manufacturing paperwork and instructions.
  • Perform physical counting, reconciliation, and reorganization of materials.
  • Retrieve, replenish, and verify materials, including material notification when required.
  • Perform required system transactions related to inventory and material movement.
  • Operate and monitor select automated production equipment; reset or service equipment as needed.
  • Drive company vehicles between facilities, as required.
  • Perform additional tasks as assigned by the General Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager/Supervisor, Manufacturing Lead, or Line Trainer.
  • Learn, follow, and adhere to Manufacturing Procedures (MPs) and company quality policies.
  • Complete manufacturing paperwork accurately and verify documentation.
  • Complete required training objectives and demonstrate training effectiveness as outlined in the training plan.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience Education

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Skills and Experience
  • Previous experience and/or training as a Material Handler preferred.
  • Basic mathematical skills to use assembly and inspection tools (e.g., rulers, gauges, reticles).
  • Introductory-level computer proficiency.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English regarding manufacturing procedures, workflows, equipment setup, and work instructions.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand and/or sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to distinguish between colors, as required for product identification and signaling systems.
  • Strong manual dexterity to handle, count, and manipulate materials.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks throughout an entire shift.
  • Ability to learn and work in a cleanroom environment.
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with occasional movement to transport materials or communicate with manufacturing leadership.
  • Ability to operate equipment to assemble or prepare parts manually and inspect work accuracy per manufacturing processes.


Physical Job Requirements
  • Manufacturing and cleanroom work environment.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
  • The employee frequently is required to talk and hear.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise levels in the work environment are typically very quiet.

job.description:
Implementation Specialist
6 month contract to hire
Irving, TX (Onsite)

Seeking a highly motivated, self-directed, Implementation Specialist for their IT Implementation and Adoption Group, located in Irving, Texas. This position works closely with the IT development, training, and support groups to develop rollout plans, schedules, training events, and project communications. This position will coordinate resources and administer events. This position will assist with IT system training and application support for new location or acquisition setups; and for administering and supporting pilot programs for new software initiatives.

REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelors’ degree with major work in business administration, education, computer sciences, or a similar business-related field.
  • At least three years full-time employment working in a related area.
  • Must be able to analyze business process and procedures, and software applications to identify key training points and develop training programs to support them.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Work, PowerPoint, Outlook); advanced experience with MS Excel is required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and listening skills.
  • Must be able to demonstrate experience in persuading and motivating others. Exercises tact, sound judgment and self-discipline.

  • Experience in developing training materials and presenting training to small groups.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

job.title: Engineer Vehicle Tools – Datalogging, Fleet Analytics & Tools Management
job.description:
Engineer Vehicle Tools – Datalogging, Fleet Analytics & Tools Management
 
This role sits at the intersection of vehicle engineering, data analytics, and fleet operations. You will own the health and performance of our Intrepid CS-based datalogging systems across the engineering vehicle fleet, build tools and dashboards that turn raw fleet data into actionable insight, and manage the shared engineering tools (Vector licenses, portable hardware) that keep test programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a CAN network, writing a Python script to mine a data pool for anomalies, and coordinating logistics across multiple test sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Partner with cloud and data platform teams to build dashboards and metrics covering both fleet logging health and the logged vehicle data itself.
  • Develop diagnostics and trend analyses that characterize software and system behavior in the field to inform program development and control system tuning.
  • Build internal tools/scripts to mine fleet data pools for issues or trends that may not be readily apparent to end users.
Fleet Logging Operations
  • Perform regular checks of fleet logging status; proactively identify and report issues to minimize data downtime.
  • Manage fleet-wide logger logistics, including unit delivery, rework, part swaps, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Conduct initial triage on non-functioning loggers and escalate to the appropriate point of contact for resolution.
  • Support additional/bespoke instrumentation requests driven by evolving vehicle testing needs.
Logging Solution Development
  • Support development of external logging solutions for upcoming build phases, coordinating compatibility, integration, and prove-out as vehicle builds mature and harness designs evolve.
  • Create setup and troubleshooting guides/documentation for external datalogging systems.
Tools & Asset Management
  • Maintain and track shared engineering tool licenses (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANape/vSpy) to ensure availability across teams.
  • Track portable equipment locations, usage, and lifecycle across the fleet.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field; or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience with vehicle data acquisition/CAN-based systems.
  • Strong proficiency with CAN diagnostic and log analysis tools for embedded systems, such as CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe, and MATLAB.
  • Experience with vehicle datalogging tools such as Intrepid CS, Vehicle Spy, and associated cloud/server connectivity options.
  • Working knowledge of automotive embedded systems, including chassis control ECUs, body modules, thermal management, braking, steering, and powertrain.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work both independently and cross-functionally.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience with EV platforms and modern vehicle software architecture.
  • Scripting/programming experience (e.g., Python, SQL) for data analysis and tool development.
  • Familiarity with cloud/data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks) used for large-scale fleet data.
  • Experience managing shared software licenses or engineering equipment pools.
  • Experience creating technical documentation or training materials for cross-functional teams.

job.title: Laboratory Animal Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring an Laboratory Animal Technician for our San Francisco Bay Area client. In the Animal tech role, you will support the research programs of the faculty by providing all services associated with the care and use of laboratory animals including the purchasing/receiving, daily care and monitoring of the health of all species. 

Industry: Clinical Research
Location: San Francisco, Ca
Shift: M-F  7:00 am - 3:30 pm

Responsibilities 
  • Animal care, room sanitation, record keeping and minor equipment maintenance 
  • Daily maintenance of vivarium facilities, under general supervision.
  • Change cages/racks, clean primary enclosures per schedule, feed and water different species of animals 
  • Always handle animals humanely and with care. 
  • Mistreatment can result in severe, negative employment consequences.
  • Monitor room conditions for temperature, humidity, and sanitation. 
  • Report conditions outside of set ranges to your Supervisor/Principal Technician.
  • Prepare animal cages for transportation between Vivarium's/ facilities.
  • Perform cage wash duties as needed
  • Conduct all activities according to federal, state, AAALAC, and Facility requirements and regulations, including BSL 2 and higher areas.
  • Assist in the training of new employees and act as area leader of Assistant Animal Technicians.
Qualifications
  • 1 year of animal handling or lab animal sanitation equipment operations experience 
  • Ability to communicate animal health information to appropriate personnel, maintain legible records for permanent status
  • Some computer skills (email, scan barcodes, timesheets and online training)
  • Capacity to learn and assume responsibility for the routine animal caretaking functions 
  • Able to effectively and efficiently work well with other team-members in a high-throughput, dynamic, and physically demanding environment
  • Ability to effectively follow Standard Operating Procedures as it relates to Environmental Health and Safety procedures (i.e. proper use of Personal Protective Equipment)

job.title: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Full Stack Engineer

Scope:
• Lead the Front-End Architecture for our Chemistry Insights Platform:
• Architect the AI Interface: Build a high-performance, responsive user interface that connects our scientists with a powerful, LLM-driven backend.
• Enable Agentic Workflows: Design and implement intuitive UIs for complex, multi-step AI interactions, making advanced information retrieval and data synthesis feel seamless to the end user.
• Manage Real-Time State: Utilize technologies like WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) to handle asynchronous LLM streaming, maintaining a smooth UX while agents process data in the background.
• Domain-Specific Visualization: Optimize the rendering of heavy scientific payloads, chemical structures, and large document datasets without compromising browser performance.

Required:
• Application Framework: React.js and Next.js, built strictly with TypeScript to ensure type safety across complex LLM data structures.
• Real-Time Data Streaming: Utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) to handle asynchronous, token-by-token LLM responses, ensuring our agentic workflows feel instant and highly responsive.
• State Architecture: Deep expertise in managing complex, real-time client and server state using Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or the Context API.
• Styling & Build Tooling: Tailwind CSS for rapid, scalable UI development, bundled and optimized for performance via Vite or Webpack.

Pluses:
• Experience in these areas is a massive plus, particularly for rendering complex chemical structures and handling heavy in-browser computation:
• Advanced 3D & Graphics: WebGL, WebGPU, and Three.js / React Three Fiber.
• High-Performance Compute: WebAssembly (Wasm).

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, excel in detail-oriented tasks, and have a passion for energy infrastructure, this is your chance to grow your career while making a tangible impact.

Job Details: 

Duration: 12 month contract W2
Pay Rate:  $24.65-$35.21 hourly
Hybrid 2x a week onsite - Audubon PA

Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Over 5 years of experience in a similar role
  • Exceptional attention to detail and high-quality work standards
  • Effective communicator, both verbally and in writing
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Nice to Have Skills:
  • Experience with SAP
